text:
Hilarious "war" between the fan bases. Anyway, didn't know of this song until Nayeon covered it. Went over to see the original version and was even more impressed (though I'm not an AG fan).


I'm kind of confused though as to why Twice would even release this. They are big enough and have enough resources to do all original songs at this point no? JYP could hire a couple of composers and get something like this done relatively quickly. Kpop songs are for the most part more complex and harder to produce than western ditties these days, and avoid any comparisons/backlash that can accompany covers. Smaller groups might get away with it, but Twice I think is beyond that stage by now.
